svg.title: From fitted Elastix coefficients to the displayed paired image
svg.desc: Elastix fits reduced views and writes original transform-parameter files. The application retains equivalent affine coefficients, cubic B-spline grid coefficients and image calibration in its portable saved record. Its Java coefficient evaluator maps fixed mIF coordinates to paired-image coordinates; one supported cubic query uses displacement vectors at sixteen surrounding control points. Warpy's existing RealTransformImageServer uses that evaluator to sample requested original paired-image tiles. Qt receives selected channel values and their coordinates and applies display colour and opacity; the same transformed image reader also supplies QuPath. The dashed blue arrow is a viewport request; solid teal arrows carry fitted values, coordinates or pixels. The separate check sends the original fitted parameter files and 49 mIF physical coordinates to Transformix. The same 49 coordinates are independently evaluated from the saved record; the maximum difference must be at most 0.01 paired-image pixels. Transformix performs a coordinate check, not a second fit or the interactive image rendering. The tissue glyphs, lattice vectors, point marks and displayed crop are schematic, not observations or a numerical accuracy result.
svg.text: C Check the fitted coordinate map
